matt slade.name: Matt Slade
matt slade.origin: ===Origin=== Matt Slade was the son of homesteader Bill Slade. They settled on government land outside of the town of Last Draw but were burned off their land by a wealthy rancher named Kisco Graves. Homeless and penniless, the pair roamed the country looking for work when they ran into Po Jelks and his gang. Unaware that they were outlaws, the two gladly accepted a job to tend to their horses for 10 dollars. They soon realized that they were hired to facilitate in a bank robbery. After the robbery was a success, Bill Slade demanded Po for payment and was shot dead in front of Matt's eyes. Matt buried his father in a nearby canyon and vowed to become a great gunfighter and avenge his father's death. Growing up, Matt took odd jobs and bought himself a pair of guns and trained how to shoot becoming an expert gunfighter and a "wizard of the cross-draw". However his involvement in the Po Jelks bank robbery had him labelled as an outlaw and his name was further tarnished by other crimes that were erroneously blamed on him. By the time Matt was an adult he was a wanted man with a reward on his head for $1,000.00 dead or alive. ===US Marshal=== One day while getting out of a scrape in the Carson City Hotel, a lantern fell over causing a massive fire that trapped a young girl inside. Unable to leave the young girl to burn alive, Matt went back and saved her life burning his hands in the process, and then fled town. Seeking shelter in an abandoned shack, Matt was approached by Anson Clinton, the governor of the territories and the father of Judy, the young girl he rescued. Anson had come with a pardon, having deduced that Slade was not guilty of any of the crimes he was accused of except for the Jelks robbery of many years ago. However, after hearing Matt tell his tale, Anson decided to go through with the pardon anyway and then offered Slade a job working as an undercover US Marshal. Matt accepted the job, and his first assignment was to take down the Hole-in-the-Wall gang who had been terrorizing the region for some time. Matt used his reputation as a gunfighter to petition for membership in the gang in the hopes of infiltrating their ranks and taking them down from the inside. However as fate would have it, Slade found that the Hole-in-the-Wall gang's leader was none other than Po Jelks. Matt intentionally blew his cover and single handedly beat the entire gang in a gun fight and took them into custody, sparing Po's life so that he would face justice for his crimes. Shortly thereafter Matt got another opportunity to square his past when his next assignment brought him back to Last Draw where Kisco Graves was still driving homesteaders off the government land. There Matt easily out shot Graves's hired guns and beat Graves in a fist fight, ordering him out of town and warning him of the grave repercussions if he should ever return. Some of Matt's earliest assignments involved clearing out the outlaws from Bucktown along with saloon owner Cobra Cane and the corrupt mayor Brad Ferris. He also helped defend reformed outlaw Ben Trumbull defend himself from his former boss Curly Bill. On the trail of "Flash" Kellogg, Matt was unable to save him when his horse threw him Flash off a cliff. However his resemblance to Kellogg allowed him to help Flash's sister keep from having her family land swindled away from her by Mr. Bard. Elsewhere in Texas, Slade came to the aid of his friend Don Sebastian, whose property was taken over by Hawk Mosby and his gang who were trying to prevent Sebastian from selling a portion of his land to the local railroad. He also uncovered a plot by Clooney, a local circus owner, and a local Express Office employee to rob the Express office. While on the trail of the Utah Kid in the Mojave Desert, Matt's horse was killed and he was left to die in the desert. He came across a wild grey stallion that was also near death in the desert. Helping the horse get to water he nursed it back to health. After capturing the Utah Kid, the horse insisted that he ride it, and he took it for his own, naming the grey stallion Eagle. Slade was later framed for robbing a stagecoach by an outlaw named Mort and was confined to a jail in Dobbs Wells. However, when the real thief tried to kill Slade, Matt was able to clear his name. Matt soon found himself coming to the defence of the town of Crescent, the place where he earned his reputation as an outlaw when it came under threat from Trigger Clay and his gang. Unaware that Slade had been pardoned and was secretly a US Marshal, the locals refused to let him help until it was too late, but ultimately Slade helped the locals of Crescent stop Clay and his gang. He later stopped Bull "The Schemer" who tried to lure Slade away from town to rob the local bank. He also stopped trader Eric Bard from providing renegade Apaches led by Todecka with firearms. ===Kid Slade=== By this time, Matt had adopted the nickname "Kid" Slade, and continued in his capacity as an undercover US mar

matt slade iii.name: Matt Slade III
matt slade iii.origin: Matt Slade III was piloting a prototype of the experimental XF5U-2 Flapjack plane, and crashed somewhere in Poland when a washer blew. There he was captured by Nazi soldiers and held by General Skul during World War II in Murder Mountain. He came under the sway of Skul's daughter, Gretchyn Skul. When the Sky-Wolves came to his rescue, he turned a gun on them, thinking they were Nazis attempting to trick him. They were able to convince him that they were there on the request of his father to rescue him and they all escaped back to the Lobo II. The next day Slade joined the Sky-Wolves and returned to Murder Mountain, blowing it up. After this mission Slade, along with the rest of the Sky-Wolves, decided to remain together to fight against the Nazi threat.

matt wilkie.name: Matt Wilkie
matt wilkie.origin: Matt Wilkie is a man who works as the receptionist for Marvel Studios. One day, the She-Hulk of Earth-199999 came into the studio's main office and asked Wilkie if she could speak with K.E.V.I.N.. Wilkie then handed her an NDA to sign while he called K.E.V.I.N. to ask he could let She-Hulk through. When K.E.V.I.N. denied the request, Wilkie pressed a button to call Marvel Security, who attempted to stop She-Hulk from speaking with K.E.V.I.N..

matthew gabriel.name: Matthew (Gabriel)
matthew gabriel.origin: The man known as Agent Matthew worked for S.T.R.I.K.E. during the time when the crime lord Vixen infiltrated and took over the organization. Later when S.T.R.I.K.E. folded, Matthew went to work for the R.C.X. under the new code name Gabriel, where he worked with other agents taking care of the children who would come to be known as the Warpies. In fact Gabriel, Agent Michael and the other agents were responsible for collecting the children inflicted by Mad Jim Jaspers's reality warp, even going as far as stealing them from their birth parents. Eventually the R.C.X. agents were forced to move their charges from an abandoned prison to Braddock Manor, where Agent Michael attempted to force control of the manor from Brian Braddock, also known as Captain Britain. Brian was opposed to the idea of R.C.X. or the Warpies living in the Manor, but his sister Betsy Braddock was for it as well the sentient computer system known as Mastermind. Eventually Brian left the Manor with Meggan to move into their lighthouse. Agent Michael and Mastermind convinced Betsy to take on the mantle of the new Captain Britain, against the advice of Gabriel to not do it. While operating as Captain Britain, Betsy was severely beaten and blinded by the Slaymaster on the order of the Vixen. Later the year at Christmas, as Betsy and Gabriel became engaged and decided to leave Braddock Manor to travel to Switzerland to stay with Betsy's good friend, Alison Double so she could recuperate. Whatever happened after they arrived is unknown at present, but by the time Betsy was abducted by Mojo and Spiral he had left without her. Some years later, Gabriel, Michael and the other R.C.X. agents were discovered by members of the team Excalibur in suspended animation pods in the underground complex known as Cloud Nine. matthew gabriel.bio: The man known as Agent Matthew worked for S.T.R.I.K.E. during the time when the crime lord Vixen infiltrated and took over the organization. Later when S.T.R.I.K.E. folded, Matthew went to work for the R.C.X. under the new code name Gabriel, where he worked with other agents taking care of the children who would come to be known as the Warpies. In fact Gabriel, Agent Michael and the other agents were responsible for collecting the children inflicted by Mad Jim Jaspers's reality warp, even going as far as stealing them from their birth parents. Eventually the R.C.X. agents were forced to move their charges from an abandoned prison to Braddock Manor, where Agent Michael attempted to force control of the manor from Brian Braddock, also known as Captain Britain. Eventually Brian left the Manor with Meggan to move into their lighthouse. While operating as Captain Britain, Betsy was severely beaten and blinded by the Slaymaster on the order of the Vixen. Later the year at Christmas, as Betsy and Gabriel became engaged and decided to leave Braddock Manor to travel to Switzerland to stay with Betsy's good friend, Alison Double so she could recuperate. Whatever happened after they arrived is unknown at present, but by the time Betsy was abducted by Mojo and Spiral he had left without her. matthew axel.name: Matthew Axel
matthew axel.species: Public Eye's tech who assist The Punisher in his mission.
matthew axel.origin: Matt Axel was a Public Eye tech and friend of Jake Gallows, the Punisher. He played the tech support to Jake as Microchip, Henri, or Stuart Clarke had done for Frank Castle, creating more and more of his weapons, using his work as a cover. He also conceived the Punishment Hotel under Jake's house. thumb|left|350px|Taking Saber Hagen (Earth-928)|Saber Hagen under his care He was one of the rare philanthropists of his age, assisting the Degens and taking care of them in his his Degens Hostel. During a time, he was helped by the young Saber Hagen, a Degens born from military experimentation subjects and who later became the Public Enemy. As Punisher's support, he quickly became frightened by Jake's change of mind, his schizophrenia, expeditive methods, and finally was done with helping him. ===Public Enemy File=== With the Public Enemy rise, he came to see Matt who reproved his actions and made him stop, but he was then targeted by the Punisher, considering he had betrayed him in hiding Saber, and in providing him an unloaded gun to confront the Red Dog. In a psychotic state, Jake stated that the Punisher personality had taken control of him, and stopped his attack. ===One Nation Under Doom=== When the Punisher was appointed head of the Punishment Police by President Doom, Matt went paranoiac and rebuilt the robot Gold Heart as "The Real Punisher", considering that his former friend had became a pawn of the corporations. He was then considered by Jake as an enemy and targeted. Jake quickly became crazy about Matt and soon was considered by Doom as unstable, and he tried to eliminate him. Matt Axel rejoined his hideout, intending to flee from Earth, but his transport was requisitioned by Jake, now a fugitive himself.

matthew beacher.name: Matthew Beacher
matthew beacher.origin: Matthew Beacher was the step-brother of Slyde. Matthew was once kidnapped by the Maggia and held for ransom. Slyde, with help from Luke Cage and Spider-Man, rescued Matthew. Matthew acted as Slyde when his step-brother was incarcerated. He was later killed and resurrected by the Hand and forced to become one of its members. He also wore a costume like the one his brother used. During an assault against a S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier, Slyde fought Wolverine along with several other villains. Wolverine eventually killed him.

matthew caniglia.name: Matthew Caniglia
matthew caniglia.origin: Matthew Caniglia was the only child born to Doc Justice and Sarah Jo, the first Princess Justice. Together, they were "the First Family of Justice." Unfortunately, Sarah Jo died on a mission when Matthew was still an infant. After years begging Doc Justice to take him on as his new protégé, Matthew finally became the second Kid Justice at age seventeen. In addition to himself and Doc Justice, the new J-Team roster included SPF, Trench, and the third Princess Justice. At some point in time, Matthew became involved in Doc Justice's scheme to routinely kill off members of the J-Team to raise his own profile as the stalwart hero of Los Angeles, which Matthew genuinely believed helped him protect the city. He eventually retired from active superheroics and began providing technical support to Doc Justice following an operation called "Clear Slate," that disbanded the J-Team, leaving Matthew's superhero alter-ego as missing in action. When Doc Justice brought the Runaways under his wing, Matthew provided them with costumes and was joined by Gert Yorkes in monitoring the missions of Doc Justice and the new J-Team, later offering to teach her how to run Mission Control. 200px|thumb|left|Matthew as Kid Justice with Doc Justice and the new J-Team While monitoring one of the J-Team's missions, Gert became curious about the team's former members, and Matthew went over the history of the team with her. She became suspicious of the high mortality rate of Doc Justice's protégés, and later looked through Matthew's computer, eventually discovering the truth behind their deaths. Matthew tried to stop her from rushing to the scene of an ongoing mission that was planned to end with Karolina Dean's death at the hands of SPF, but Gert convinced him to help her. Together with Gert's pet dinosaur Old Lace, the two managed to intercept the staged mission. Matthew briefly held his father at gunpoint, but lacked the conviction to stand up against him, and quickly desisted. The incident ended when Victor Mancha arrived and immobilized Doc Justice long enough for Old Lace to sink her teeth on him. Matthew tended to SPF and left the scene with her, leaving his father's body behind.

matthew clinton.name: Matthew Clinton
matthew clinton.origin: The attorney of Josiah Harrow, a wealthy eccentric, Matthew Clinton was aware of a clause on Harrow’s will dividing the estate up among his surviving relatives. At some point, Clinton thus entered into an alliance with Harrow’s son-in-law Manuel Perez after Josiah’s death, with the intention of murdering Harrow’s other heirs and framing Josiah’s brother for the crimes. He played the part of the deceased’s loyal legal counsel well, admonishing Jim Slade for upsetting the other assembled heirs with talk of a murderer on the loose. He also took steps to make sure they all remained on the grounds of the manor with a false telegraph from Philip Avery, claiming he would be late and asking for the reading of the will to be postponed. As a result, his and Perez’s would-be victims stayed close by and would have been picked off one by one if not for the interference of Captain America and Bucky. In the end, the two heroes caught and unmasked Perez as the masked murderer and also narrowly avoided being shot by Clinton. He claimed that he had been aiming at Perez to avenge his victims, but Cap managed to discern the truth, that Clinton and Perez had been killing Harrow’s heirs so the estate would be divided among them alone. Tying up the conspirators, Cap revealed the truth to the surviving heirs, Lucy Harrow and Josiah’s brother, before he and Bucky returned to nearby Camp Lehigh.
